summary: Once U.S. Senator Katie Prairie's 2028 Supported Companions, Waiver Portability, and Social Security Solvency Act takes effect on January 1, 2029, David, Katie, Nate, Heather, and Brittany unveil two inch-for-inch mirrored ground-floor companion suites in Virginia Beach and Alexandria—giving Wesley and Chelsea their own connected daytime sanctuary while keeping all six together every night on their solid-oak Alaskan King.
html:
Archival Note: Once U.S. Senator Katie Prairie passes her landmark Supported Companions, Waiver Portability, and Social Security Solvency Act (2028) and President Clara Morales signs it in the restored White House Rose Garden (Episode 11, Chapter 7, Part 2), repealing 1972 SSI/DAC marriage, in-kind family shelter, and Form SSA-4178 holding-out penalties nationwide, our household unveils two architecturally mirrored 520-square-foot ground-floor companion suites in March 2029—paired seamlessly with our nine-foot solid-oak six-person Alaskan King platform beds!

1. Two Mirrored Daytime Companion Suites + Full-Time Six-Person Alaskan King Nights

Because our unbroken six-person household (Wesley, Heather, Nate, Katie, Chelsea, and Brittany) splits Senate session weeks between Virginia Beach (Thursday through Sunday) and Sunset Drive in Alexandria (Monday through Wednesday via ARTS Business Class), building a companion and turtle suite at only one house would have broken Wesley's and Chelsea's routine half of every week.

Our barrier-free architect built two inch-for-inch identical 520-square-foot zero-step ground-floor companion suites:

  1. The Kempsville Garden Suite (Virginia Beach, VA — District Weeks, Weekends, & Holidays):
    • Connected directly into our main family kitchen through an unlocked solid-oak interior pocket door—so Uncle David (before October 2031), Heather, Brittany, Katie, and Nate are ten steps away while Wesley and Chelsea tear neat romaine squares for Sunny and Pebble in their 75-gallon oak-cabinet habitat!
  2. The Old Town Garden Suite (Sunset Drive, Alexandria, VA — U.S. Senate Session Weeks):
    • Connected directly to the Sunset Drive kitchen (one level block from King Street–Old Town) through an identical unlocked solid-oak interior pocket door, with a matching 75-gallon basking habitat housing a calm second pair of rescued painted turtles so no animal is ever stressed in transit.

Both suites share the exact same floor plan down to the half-inch: an oatmeal-linen loveseat on the same wall, the 75-gallon basking turtle habitat on the right-hand oak cabinet, a cool-touch roll-under tea kitchenette with zero open burners, and a quiet afternoon reading-and-nap daybed alcove.

And every single night at 9:30 PM—in both Virginia Beach and Alexandria—once Wesley and Chelsea switch their turtle tank to its amber night lamp, both of them walk right back through the open oak pocket door into the master suite to sleep on our nine-foot (108" x 108") solid-oak wheelchair-transfer-height Alaskan King platform bed:

  • Wesley — Heather — Nate — Katie — Chelsea — Brittany
  • Migrating Wesley full-time onto the Alaskan King right next to Heather (starting February 11, 2017) means Wesley goes to sleep every single night knowing Heather is right beside him—never waking up scared in a side room alone—while Nate sleeps right between his wife Heather and his twin sister Katie, with Chelsea and Brittany tucked warmly beside Katie!

2. Loving Guardrails: Respecting Plenary Guardianship & What Remains Off-Limits

With Title III of Katie's 2028 Act backing their Supported Companion Declaration (#00001) co-signed by David Prairie (succeeded by Brittany Fletcher) and Heather Prairie, our household lovingly upholds the real-world cognitive and legal protections that keep Wesley and Chelsea safe:

  1. No Buying Real Estate, Signing Mortgages, or Taking On Debt: Under their court-supervised plenary conservatorships, both homes, utilities, insurance policies, and repairs remain 100% owned and managed by the family—shielding Wesley and Chelsea completely from predatory lenders or commercial contracts.
  2. Ten-Second Family Proximity (Zero Isolated Living Alone): Because Chelsea has moderate-to-severe asthma and Wesley communicates primarily non-verbally and in short earnest phrases, that open oak pocket door during the day—and sharing our Alaskan King every night—keeps trained, loving family hands right beside them 24/7.
  3. Protected Fiduciary & ABLE Accounts (Zero Benefit Cuts): With Form SSA-4178 holding-out penalties repealed forever, Wesley and Chelsea keep 100% of their protected benefits and ABLE savings accounts managed transparently by Heather and Brittany.
